text:
Residing in the palace of the essence of the <term>dharmadhatu</term> <gloss>the sphere of reality</gloss>, which is supreme above all in the three realms, he dwells together with a great assembly of monks and a great assembly of <term>bodhisattvas</term> <gloss>enlightened beings</gloss>. These are: the <term>bodhisattva</term> <gloss>enlightened being</gloss> and great being Non-Conceptual, and Non-Conceptual Radiance, and Non-Conceptual Moon, and Non-Conceptual Hero, and the skilled teacher of the non-conceptual <term>dharma</term> <gloss>teachings</gloss>, and Non-Conceptual Essence, and Non-Conceptual

<summary>This passage describes the Buddha residing in a transcendent palace, surrounded by a vast assembly of monks and bodhisattvas who embody various aspects of non-conceptual wisdom.</summary>
<keywords>dharmadhatu, bodhisattva, non-conceptual, three realms, assembly</keywords>
